title: Load the hero chapter with the 3D background ready
description: A visitor can land on the homepage and see the hero chapter become usable with the animated background loaded.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the hero headline and supporting content are visible
Verify the 3D background is displayed and ready for interaction

title: Load the homepage hero and 3D background
description: Verify that a visitor can load the homepage, wait for initialization, and see the first chapter with the 3D background ready to use.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the loading screen to complete
Verify the hero chapter is visible
Verify the 3D background is displayed

title: Submit the contact form with valid details
description: Verify that a visitor can reach the contact section, submit the form with complete details, and receive success feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the loading screen to complete
Scroll to the contact section
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Fill in the message field with a valid message
Submit the contact form
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Open and close the mobile navigation menu
description: Verify that a mobile user can expand the navigation menu and collapse it again without leaving the homepage unusable.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the loading screen to complete
Resize the viewport to a mobile size
Open the mobile navigation menu
Verify the mobile navigation menu is visible
Collapse the mobile navigation menu
Verify the mobile navigation menu is hidden

title: Scroll through chapters as the 3D scene updates
description: Verify that scrolling through the homepage progresses through chapters and updates the 3D background while the page remains usable.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the loading screen to complete
Scroll down through the page
Verify the visible chapter changes as the page is scrolled
Verify the 3D background responds to scrolling

title: Toggle the theme on mobile and keep the portfolio usable
description: Verify that a mobile user can switch between light and dark themes and continue browsing the portfolio.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the loading screen to complete
Resize the viewport to a mobile size
Toggle the theme
Verify the theme appearance changes
Toggle the theme again
Verify the original theme appearance is restored

title: Jump from hero to projects using the main call to action
description: A visitor can use the hero call to action to jump directly to the projects section and continue browsing work.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the primary call to action in the hero
Verify the projects section is displayed
Verify the hero chapter is no longer the active focus

title: Navigate between chapters with the fixed navigation
description: Verify that a user can move between portfolio chapters using the fixed navigation and reach different sections successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the loading screen to complete
Click a chapter navigation link for an interior section
Verify the selected chapter section is visible
Click a chapter navigation link for a different section
Verify the newly selected chapter section is visible

title: Browse the project list in the projects chapter
description: A visitor can reach the projects chapter and review the curated portfolio items.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the projects section
Verify the project list is visible
Verify multiple projects are displayed

title: View the about chapter with bio and skill cards
description: A visitor can scroll to the about chapter and review the creator bio and skill-focused cards.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the about section
Verify the bio content is visible
Verify the skill cards are displayed

title: Browse selected projects and open external project links
description: Verify that a user can view the projects section and open both a live demo and a GitHub repository link from an active project.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the loading screen to complete
Scroll to the projects section
Verify selected projects are displayed
Open a live demo link for an active project
Verify the external project destination opens successfully
Return to the portfolio
Open the GitHub source link for an active project
Verify the repository destination opens successfully

title: See the hero scroll indicator with the introductory content
description: A visitor can recognize the scroll affordance in the hero while viewing the landing chapter.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the scroll indicator is visible
Verify the hero introduction remains visible

title: Show validation when the contact form is incomplete
description: Verify that a visitor receives validation feedback when trying to submit the contact form with required information missing.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the loading screen to complete
Scroll to the contact section
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Leave the email or message field incomplete
Submit the contact form
Verify a validation error is visible

title: Open a live demo from an active project
description: A visitor can open the live demo for an active project from the projects chapter.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the projects section
Click the live demo link for an active project
Verify the demo destination opens
Verify the portfolio page is still accessible in the original tab

title: Open a GitHub repository from an active project
description: A visitor can open the source repository for an active project from the projects chapter.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the projects section
Click the source code link for an active project
Verify the repository destination opens
Verify the project remains identifiable in the portfolio

title: Read the about section and review skill cards
description: Verify that a visitor can reach the about section and see the bio and skill cards that summarize the portfolio owner.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the loading screen to complete
Scroll to the about section
Verify the bio content is visible
Verify the skill cards are displayed

title: Move from about to projects by scrolling through chapters
description: A visitor can continue from the about chapter into the projects chapter using normal page scrolling.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the about section
Scroll further down to the projects section
Verify the projects list is displayed
Verify the about section is no longer the active focus
